edits.before: - Twisted Fate Pick a Card (Gold): matchup-defining — The locked gold card starts every trade and gank — back off the moment it glows yellow. Step up only on its downtime. - Budget W Defiant Dance for emergencies and the R for opportunities — never swap them.
edits.after: - Pick a Card is a flat 6s at every rank, and locking gold resets his attack — the wind-up is your cue to step out, not the card itself. - Wild Cards is 6s at rank 1. - Destiny is 170s at rank 1 and reveals, so ward before he roams.

edits.after: W joins, but Defiant Dance cuts physical damage only — Wild Cards comes through it untouched.

edits.before: From level 3 through 6 you keep pressing: Defiant Dance shrugs off his card pokes and Flawless Duet lets you stick through his side-step attempts, so as long as you respect Gold Card windows you win every all-in, ultimate included since his damage still can't match your dive.
edits.after: From level 3 through 6 you keep pressing, but Defiant Dance cuts physical damage only and does not blunt Wild Cards. Flawless Duet is the real tool — with no dash in his kit he cannot leave the stun. Respect the flat 6s gold-card window and you win every all-in.
